applied_revisions.value: On the Fast-WAM Base pilot with public LIBERO-fastwam train/evaluation episodes, compare BF16, matched branch-free W4A8 PTQ, ordinary action-only QAT, teacher KD at teacher states, and student-path suffix QAT while holding model, data split, schedule, chunk, controller, normalization and kernel path fixed. Measure fixed-input denormalized executed-action deviation, LIBERO closed-loop completion, and native full action-query latency as separate outcomes; the candidate predicts its completion gain over matched teacher KD increases with task-level V_visit rank, while low-V_visit tasks show little gain. As a mechanism control, permute BF16 suffix endpoints among quantized student states matched by model and solver index while preserving their marginal endpoint distribution; the predicted downstream effect is loss of the candidate's closed-loop completion gain and disappearance of the V_visit-linked gain pattern, not merely a change in V_visit itself. No teacher is used at evaluation, and transfer to shared-backbone LingBot-VA/Cosmos Policy is a separate scope-labeled falsification rather than a pooled success claim. Add matched-measured-compute controls for explicit vanilla QAT plus teacher KD, ordinary original-noise-seed endpoint KD, teacher-state suffix KD restarted from teacher-visited x_FP[m,k], and student-state per-step OPD at x_Q[m,k], matching measured teacher-query and suffix work across arms under the same contexts and paired noise/solver-index draws; a completion gain beyond these controls is the evidence relevant to the paired full-suffix endpoint target.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Added four explicitly named matched-compute controls while preserving the Fast-WAM setup, outcomes, V_visit prediction, and shuffled-target control.

applied_revisions.value: For each model m, let Q_m be the exact module set quantized by its matched branch-free W4A8 PTQ comparator and let theta_m be the existing trainable weights in Q_m; Fast-WAM uses its independent ActionDiT, while the released shared-backbone LingBot-VA and Cosmos Policy require quantizing and updating the declared shared denoiser blocks, so those results are action-targeted shared-backbone QAT rather than weight-scope action-only QAT. With conditioning c, initial noise z, and native solver innovations eta, run the fake-quantized student to its own states x_Q[m,k], containing every evolving state needed by the query: action latent for Fast-WAM and coupled video/action state for shared models. Let K_m be the model's active native solver indices and sample k uniformly from K_m; detach x_Q[m,k], then restart both BF16 teacher and quantized student from that state and apply each unchanged remaining suffix with the same c and eta. Let S[b,m,k] denote that suffix, D_m the native action denormalization map, and E_m the controller's executed-prefix selector. Let J_m be the action channels selected by E_m, and let s[m,j] > 0 be the per-channel scale specified by model m's existing action-normalization/controller contract for channel j, fixed across comparison arms. For each branch b, define y_tilde[b|Q,m,k] as its denormalized, selected command immediately before any hard clipping or gripper threshold; when gripper thresholding is present, use the continuous pre-threshold gripper command for this training signal. Define the exact executed command y[b|Q,m,k] = E_m(D_m(S[b,m,k](x_Q[m,k], c, eta_after_k))) including the model's native clipping and thresholding, and delta_visit[m,k] = y[Q|Q,m,k] - y[BF16|Q,m,k]. Train theta_m with the expectation over training contexts, native noise/innovations, and k of L_train = (1/|J_m|) sum over j in J_m of ((y_tilde[Q|Q,m,k,j] - y_tilde[BF16|Q,m,k,j]) / s[m,j]) squared; backpropagate only through the student suffix. This dimensionless continuous pre-threshold residual (or an STE if required by a model implementation) is a gradient-bearing surrogate related to, but not identical to, the exact physical-command metric; report the exact clipped/thresholded executed-command deviation separately, including per-channel values in native units. This is a suffix endpoint target, not a per-step velocity loss or a change to the solver. The teacher suffix is conditioned on a state reached by the quantized student, so its endpoint is not the teacher's original noise-seed endpoint and it is not a physical oracle; the teacher is removed completely at evaluation. Training contexts come from the existing model-specific LIBERO training data, while only internal denoising states are student-generated; this does not claim to correct environment observations induced by earlier executed actions. The same target definition transfers across architectures, but module scope, coupled state and normalization remain model-specific, and transfer is a hypothesis until tested.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Defined the channel-scaled continuous pre-threshold suffix residual and separated it from exact executed-command evaluation.

applied_revisions.value:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES
- Native WAM solvers are iterative, and changing quantized transitions can change later solver inputs; the model interfaces and common error bookkeeping define these paths, while the size and task consequence of the shift are untested — falsification target.
- A BF16 model can be queried at a state produced by its quantized counterpart; both model interfaces expose the relevant inference computation, but memory and throughput for suffix training are unmeasured.
- The action denormalizer D_m and executed-prefix selector E_m define the controller-facing output; latent error alone is not an actuator-space metric.
- Load-bearing variable and estimand: V_visit[m] is the expectation over held-out contexts c from model m's named LIBERO evaluation distribution, native initial noise z, native innovations eta, and uniformly sampled active solver index k of (1/|J_m|) times the sum over selected channels j of (delta_visit[m,k,j]/s[m,j]) squared. Here delta_visit is the exact clipped/thresholded executed-command difference, and s[m,j] comes from the existing model/controller channel scale; report exact command deviations per channel in native units as a separate outcome. The association of this dimensionless V_visit with closed-loop benefit is untested — falsification target.
- Observation model: training c is sampled from the existing training episodes for each model (Fast-WAM's public LIBERO-fastwam demonstrations for the initial pilot); episodes are temporally clustered and demonstrator-selected, not an unbiased sample of quantized-student closed-loop observations. Student-generated x_Q states expose denoising-path shift conditional on those contexts only; environmental occupancy shift remains an explicit limitation.

BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT
Naive version: initialize from the BF16 WAM, fake-quantize the matched module set to W4A8, and train it with ordinary action/denoising loss plus matched BF16 teacher KD evaluated on teacher-visited states. This is a credible baseline that may work, so branch (ii): the contribution is incremental and does not claim that generic QAT, KD, or trainable weights are novel. The added mechanism is the teacher's full remaining suffix endpoint evaluated from the quantized student's own latent state, with a dimensionless channel-scaled residual on the continuous pre-threshold command; this training surrogate is not identical to the exact clipped/thresholded physical-command metric. Whether the suffix operator is distinct from low-bit on-policy distillation, continuous-state diffusion OPD, flow-map backward simulation or behavior-state clean-endpoint anchoring remains an open prior-art question. The load-bearing artifact is this matched student-state suffix response, not generic STE training, ordinary endpoint KD, PTQ scale calibration, mixed-precision allocation, or a protected high-bit branch.

BLOCK 3 — DESIGN RATIONALE
A single mechanism closes the anchor because the unresolved variable is whether fixed-weight PTQ suffices once its own quantized solver leaves the teacher path; the action endpoint suffix target changes that training signal without adding a separate evaluation leg. I rejected environment-rollout DAgger as the core method because the available training contexts are demonstrator data and that would require an additional simulator-interaction data pipeline; closed-loop rollout remains a separate falsification. I also rejected learned quantizer scales and error-compensation branches because they would confound the weight-adaptation comparison and approach LSQ/QVGen/Q-WAM mechanisms already named in the lineage.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Aligned V_visit with existing channel scales and distinguished the training surrogate from exact executed-command evidence.

applied_revisions.value: 1. For Fast-WAM Base, LingBot-VA's released shared-backbone checkpoint, and Cosmos Policy's LIBERO model, record each BF16 reference, native schedule, action normalization/denormalization map, executed-prefix selector, and exact W4A8 PTQ module set Q_m; output a model-specific scope manifest. 2. Split each named LIBERO dataset by episode; sample training context c only from its training episodes, draw z and solver innovations from that model's native inference distribution, and run the fake-quant student to record x_Q[m,k]; output the student path states. 3. Sample k uniformly from the active native indices K_m and detach x_Q[m,k]; from this identical state and remaining innovations, run a BF16 teacher suffix and a fake-quant student suffix; output the two suffix endpoint actions. 4. Apply D_m and E_m up to any hard clip or gripper threshold to obtain each continuous pre-threshold command; use the continuous gripper signal when thresholding is present, scale each selected channel j by its existing positive model/controller scale s[m,j], and backpropagate the mean squared dimensionless residual only through the student suffix into theta_m. Separately compute and report the exact clipped/thresholded executed-command deviation per channel in native units; keep quantizer scales, schedule, excluded precision and action interface fixed. 5. Train the ordinary action-only QAT and matched teacher-KD controls with the same examples and matched measured training compute, and include the strongest runnable branch-free W4A8 PTQ comparator; report added teacher-suffix work explicitly. 6. On held-out fixed contexts and paired noise, report denormalized executed-action deviation separately from LIBERO closed-loop completion; then measure full action-query latency with the declared native W4A8 kernel, including context/video prefill, without a teacher. 7. Attempt transfer to LingBot-VA and Cosmos Policy only under their shared-backbone contracts, recording that shared blocks affect video and action states and making no weight-scope action-only claim.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Updated the training step to use the scaled continuous command surrogate and preserve exact per-channel executed-command reporting.
